author: Kevin Yien, interviewed by Lenny Rachitsky
basis: First-person repeated practice with one retrospective example
reported_outcomes: Reports learning from decision records; his Shopify example matched direction but missed some underlying reasons.
proposed_outcomes: Create repeated opportunities to compare prior reasoning with later outcomes.
limits: A market prediction log is not a replacement for doing the work; Yien states this explicitly.
Outcomes depend on luck and unavailable facts, not only reasoning quality.
AI-generated predictions would exercise a different skill from making one yourself.
review_note: Retain the dated record and scheduled revisit; AI adaptation is curator inference.
coverage: Close-read complete relevant transcript exchanges at listed timestamps and surrounding context; not full 800-line transcript; audio/video not reviewed.
